## 4. Other constructions produced useful formulas, but no phase classification

### Arbitrary squeezing does not improve the one-mode Gaussian private-information boundary

The accepted restricted Gaussian private-information boundary extends to **every one-mode Gaussian seed** and **every Gaussian displacement modulation covariance**, including squeezed seeds and improper modulation:
\[
I_c(V+M,\mathcal N_x)-I_c(V,\mathcal N_x)\le0
\qquad
\left(x\ge\frac1{\sqrt6},\ M\ge0\right).
\]
The accepted finite thermal family gives positivity below \(1/\sqrt6\), so this restricted family’s boundary is exact.

The new upper direction follows from an exact cancellation in the covariance derivative, a single-crossing integral argument, and
\[
\frac{\operatorname{atanh}\sqrt y}{\sqrt y}
\ge \frac1{1-y/3},
\qquad 0<y<1,
\]
proved coefficient by coefficient using \(3^k\ge2k+1\).

This is neither a general private-capacity converse nor a quantum-capacity theorem. It does not cover arbitrary multimode or non-Gaussian ensembles.
